out_of_box_experiment.interpretation: Order/noise did not open the evaluator or silently drop the unknown class in this bounded synthetic mechanism test. This does not prove class semantics or Ubuntu acceptance.

V1 therefore remains a control-plane safety baseline, not a semantic endpoint.
